title: RWB-S6-E6003-APP: the bar slice has no plan row for its six consumed contracts, no published bar operation, no panel or lot-status vocabulary, no next-bidder field and no window row
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R5.6, R5.7, R7.2, R7.3 and R9; split plan slices RWB-S6-E6003-APP and RWB-S6-E6003-CON; context pack S6 rwb-debtsale (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13, Temporal and Drools slides 5, 12 and 13); legacy RWB-E6-003; FSD S6 Debt sale v3 A1.4, A2.7, A2.7.2, A2.7.3.1, A2.7.3.3, A2.7.4 and Requirements served; TSD S6 Debt sale v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T3.3, T4, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1, T6.2 and T-A.1 and T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-14, R-DS-16, R-DS-40, R-DS-41 and R-DS-28; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-DBS-07
description: (1) The plan gives H = RWB-S6-E6003-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the step reads the rwb-partner licence and panel facts, requests the panel suspension, reads the rwb-case state, answers the case move, reads the rwb-access right and reads the rwb-decision package, so six consumed rows have no plan row. (2) TSD S6 T-A.1 publishes five operations (API-S6-001 to API-S6-005) and none of them is a bar, remediation or panel operation; the two endpoint rows of the legacy story are the award path API-S6-003 and the data room read API-S6-004, which are RWB-S6-E6005-APP's and RWB-S6-E5026-APP's, so the app story declares no provided operation. (3) No source publishes the panel read or the panel suspension operation names, nor the full panel_status vocabulary: R-DS-15 names active and R-DS-16 names suspended and nothing else is published. (4) No source states the lot status value taken from LOV-LOT-STATUS when a lot is released after a bar. (5) No source publishes a bid ranking or a next-bidder field: TSD S6 T3.1 carries no bid table and no bid column, so the release of R-DS-41 meets the re-offer of R-DS-28 at the lot status only and the selection of the next bidder stays with the award story. (6) DP-09 is absent from the pattern set although the library object outbox_event exists in the schema, and DP-04 and DP-08 are absent although the step evaluates the DS route set and calls rwb-access. (7) EP06 is wave 4 while rwb-debtsale is created in wave 3, and R5.6 keeps the W-MAP wave, so the conflict is raised once per service and business epic. (8) The legacy Data table names recovery_case, decision_log_entry, rule_row and role, none of which this service owns; the release writes three columns of debt_sale_lot and no field of the legacy table is written here.
evidence: split_plan.json slices RWB-S6-E6003-APP and RWB-S6-E6003-CON (H three rows, C, I and X empty, lane L-S6-G and CG-W4, wave 4, release 30 April 2027); TSD S6 T-A.1 endpoint inventory API-S6-001 to API-S6-005 and T-A.2; TSD S6 T3.1 debt_sale_lot and debt_sale_account with no bid, next-bidder or release column; TSD S6 T3.2 four lists; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-14, R-DS-15, R-DS-16, R-DS-40, R-DS-41 and R-DS-28; FSD S6 A2.7.3.1 rule table and A2.7.4.4 'No background event'; context pack service row (wave 3) and ownership rows (debt_sale_account, debt_sale_lot)
area: S6 Debt sale / EP06 bar and remediation
owner_role: Solution architect with the owners of rwb-partner, rwb-case, rwb-access and rwb-decision
proposed: Keep the plan's H row and build the app story on Day 1 against six contract fakes with a 2 s budget and a breaker; declare no provided operation and run the branch behind API-S6-003 and API-S6-004; carry the three placeholders (panel operation names, panel_status vocabulary, lot status at the release) in the text and the contract; delegate the re-offer to R-DS-28 at RWB-S6-E6005-APP; record the wave conflict once for the service and EP06

title: RWB-S6-E6003-CON: the bar baseline has no published operation, no panel or release value, no move and timer vocabulary and no field-level types in any source
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; split plan slices RWB-S6-E6003-CON and RWB-S6-E6003-APP; context pack S6 rwb-debtsale; legacy RWB-E6-003; FSD S6 Debt sale v3 A2.7.2, A2.7.3.1, A2.7.3.3, A2.7.4.4 and Screens; TSD S6 Debt sale v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T3.3, T4, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A.1 and T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-14, R-DS-16, R-DS-40, R-DS-41 and R-DS-28
description: (1) The rwb-partner panel read and the panel suspension request have no published operation name, so both consumed rows carry the placeholder. (2) No source publishes the full panel_status list; only active (R-DS-15) and suspended (R-DS-16) are named, so the response vocabulary of the suspension answer is a placeholder. (3) No source states the LOV-LOT-STATUS value taken at the release of R-DS-41, so the release element requires a value the source does not give. (4) TSD S6 T-A.2 gives the error set as status codes with no message ID per condition, so each condition is bound to a message of the legacy and FSD set. (5) TSD S6 T3.1 gives physical types but publishes no OpenAPI element, so the element names, required flags and field formats are fixed by this baseline. (6) No source publishes a case-move operation; the move is declared on the workflow boundary as the stage outcome the parent CaseWorkflow applies. (7) The window of R-DS-40 carries a 10-working-day target but no source declares a Schedule, a Job row or a stored window column, so the window is declared as a durable workflow timer. (8) The plan's C, I and X rows of this slice are empty while the baseline declares six consumed rows.
evidence: TSD S6 T-A.1 five operations and no bar or panel operation; T-A.2 error lists 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 503 without message IDs; TSD S6 T3.1 field list of the two tables; TSD S6 T3.2 four lists with no panel list; TSD S6 T5.2 module interfaces only; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-40 (Timer 10 working days) and R-DS-41 (Timer None); context pack connection-matrix row S6 (REST to P5, Temporal to P7, listens to P5 and P8, file to P2)
area: S6 Debt sale / EP06 bar contract baseline
owner_role: Solution architect with the owners of rwb-partner, rwb-case, rwb-access and rwb-decision
proposed: Publish one additive OpenAPI 3.1 fragment with the bar element embedded in the answers of API-S6-002 and API-S6-004, no provided operation, one envelope and one message ID per error condition, six consumed rows with the placeholders, the four closed lists, the two move names, the four route states, the window as a durable timer, eight fakes and five new contract tests; tag the baseline as Draft and collect the consumer sign-off
